english: You approach the wall where Detect Secret revealed something.
Your gloved fingers trace the surface.
But the magical signature is strong.
You press hard against the stone.
Not a hidden door that opens by pressure.
This is the Roots, you know. Unless the City Below somehow moved the walls right under the Garden, this shouldn't contain anything strange.
Like the Arcane Lock at the tea shop.
This is it. This is the sealed entrance. The one the cultist wrote about.
Just a wall. Unless you know better.
Still just looks like a wall to me.
A very pretty wall, mind you.
Can I try to break down this wall?
E-I guess I should look around for more clues.
That will eventually work. Obviously. But you might not have the time.
Something. You are missing something here.
It is simply too thick of a slab.
You must find another lead in this case.
Remember: a true man is one who carries a sword - but knows when to keep it sheathed.
I'm still firmly on team this-is-a-wall.
The Draconic words echo in the chamber.
Then the wall begins to shimmer- and then FLASH...!
The cultist's seal has been broken.
